title: ReportHandoffRequestTimeout
description: Sent in response to a Query Handoff Request Timeout message.  The handoff request timeout is the maximum amount of time between a client reasserting its desire for a handoff before that request for a handoff is considered timed out.

HandoffRequestTimeout.comment: The handoff request timeout is the maximum amount of time between a client reasserting its desire for a handoff before that request for a handoff is considered timed out. A value of zero indicates this feature is disabled.
